verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships an `edge0 serve` command exposing an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, and macOS has a local daemon. However, the only documented example targets 127.0.0.1:8000, which is loopback only, so access from other devices on the network is not shown. Missing for 10: documented host/bind option (e.g. 0.0.0.0) for LAN exposure, network auth/access-control guidance, independent or hands-on confirmation of serving to other devices.
